description:
At Sanity.io, we're building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will embed with our most strategic customers and agency partners to co-build production solutions on the Sanity platform — content models that match how a business actually operates, automated editorial and content workflows, omnichannel delivery, and the AI-powered content operations that bring it all together. You are a founding member of a new team: what you build in one engagement becomes a reusable solution the whole company can sell and deploy. This is not staff augmentation and not billable services delivery — it is an investment role, deployed where deep technical work creates outsized business leverage, and measured on the solutions you ship, the adoption they drive, and how far they travel beyond the account you built them in.

What you would do:

Find interesting use cases

  • Leverage your knowledge of the product to find and develop use cases with strategic customers, agencies or partners which leverage the newest and most compelling aspects of the Sanity platform.

  • Clearly triage and prioritize the value to the client, and the value of the case study created against effort, time, and likelihood of completion and success.

Co-build solutions with strategic customers

  • Embed in selected strategic accounts and ship production solutions across the full breadth of the Sanity platform — modeling the customer's business in structured content, automating their content operations, and powering every channel from one source of truth — driving adoption of Sanity AI Content Operations Use Cases.

  • Build AI-forward, art-of-the-possible solutions in robust proof-of-concept or production: agents, AI-powered content workflows, and automation that show what the AI Content Operating System makes possible — built on real systems the customer runs, not stock demos.

  • Shape each engagement with the customer's engineering and content leadership: define the solution, hold the scope, and land it with a clear handoff — the engagement ends with the customer taking it over, not depending on you.

Co-build with strategic agency and technical partners

  • Partner with the engineering teams of our strategic partners to co-build accelerators, integrations, marketplace apps, or solutions that the partner can use and deliver to their own clients.

  • Transfer patterns, not just code: leave teams able to build and extend the solution without you.

Turn engagements into a reusable solution portfolio

  • Convert what your engagements surface into reusable, art-of-the-possible solutions — reference implementations, content operations patterns, agents, and accelerators — packaged so any account team can demonstrate, sell, and deploy them.

  • Document, generalize, and maintain the solutions you contribute to the portfolio, and support the field when they re-sell or re-deploy them.

Connect the field to the product

  • Fully partner with Solution Architect and Content Operations Specialist on accounts: SA covers architecture, COS covers content operations strategy, you cover execution of novel, flagship use cases.

  • Turn what you see in the field into structured, prioritized signal for Product and Engineering: what customers are trying to do, where the platform bends, and what the next platform capability should be.

About you:

  • Based in: North America or Europe (remote, with travel to customer and partner sites)

  • A track record of shipping production solutions on modern content platforms — structured content models, content-driven applications, and automated editorial workflows — including AI-powered systems such as agents and LLM applications, not just prototypes or demos

  • 7+ years across software engineering, applied AI, or solutions/forward-deployed engineering, with significant time building directly with customers or in customer-facing delivery

  • Deep familiarity with modern content and web architecture; hands-on experience with Sanity or comparable structured-content platforms is a strong signal

  • Comfortable owning an engagement end to end in ambiguous territory: you can walk into a customer's stack, find the highest-leverage build, and ship it without a spec

  • Credibility in the room with customer engineers and their leadership: you can present an architecture to a CTO, pair with their senior engineers, and hold the line on scope

  • Portfolio instinct: you see the reusable solution inside the one-off build, and you write, document, and generalize your work so others can run with it

  • Judgment about where deep technical investment creates business leverage — and the honesty to flag an engagement that won't generalize

What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive stock options program and location-based salary

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised an $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 200+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here: https://www.sanity.io/blog/our-sanity-values

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
